title: Veo for video

body.text: text-to-video model: describe a scene and get a video clip
— set the camera movement, atmosphere, and style. Great for b-roll, social content, and prototyping ad ideas.

example: "A drone clip flying over rice terraces in the morning, light mist, the sun just rising, camera moving slowly forward"

title: Write video prompts

body.text: Video needs more thought than a 2D still:
the subject's motion and the camera's movement (pan, zoom, tracking)
— specify both clearly and the clip looks intentional, not a still image moving on its own.

example: "A cat walking on an old city wall, camera tracking from the side, leaves drifting past the lens, indie-film tone"

question: What does a video prompt need to consider beyond a still image?

options.text: B-roll, social content, and ad prototypes

question: To create a short video from a description, what should you use?
To write a good video prompt, what should you specify?

options.text: The scene, motion, tone, and desired length
